kind: official gazetteer (Government of Bombay), vol. I
title: The Gazetteer of Bombay City and Island, Volume I (1909)
creator: S. M. Edwardes, compiler, for the Government of Bombay
interest: Colonial government compiler; records the Company's and Government's own works favourably and from Company-era writers; the account of the seven islands is the compiler's reconstruction from old Marathi documents and early European writers.

kind: official gazetteer (Government of Bombay), vol. II
title: The Gazetteer of Bombay City and Island, Volume II (1909)
creator: S. M. Edwardes, compiler, for the Government of Bombay
interest: As S01. The Hornby anecdote is quoted from Maclean's Guide to Bombay, a secondary work.

title: Mumbai DRMMP, City Profile of Greater Mumbai
creator: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (MCGM) and EMI
interest: Owner of the city's area figures and a disaster-management planner; its history section is a compilation from secondary works (Mumbai Pages, Da Cunha, Duff) and is used only where it matches the Gazetteer.
